ITEM 1 | Two rectangular flatbread pieces, each about 6.5 x 8.5 cm and under 1 cm thick, with blistered, browned edges and a pale golden-brown base; they sit on the plate in a stacked pair with a thin gap between them. | 70

ITEM 2 | Opaque white cheese layer, soft and slightly glossy, covering the central and lower parts of both pieces, with small melted patches. | 30

ITEM 3 | Scattered small crumbles and chunks of reddish-brown, slightly glossy, moist topping distributed over both pieces, with some orange-red sauce visible between them. | 15

ITEM 4 | Thin purple-red onion rings, about 0.3 cm wide and 3 to 5 cm long, lying across the cheese on both pieces. | 8

ITEM 5 | Dark olive-brown, matte, slightly leathery pieces, about 2 x 1.5 cm each, one on each piece, with a faint dry surface. | 6

ITEM 6 | Thin streak of pale reddish sauce, about 0.3 cm wide and 11 cm long, running from the gap between the pieces toward the right side of the plate, with a slightly wet sheen. | 2
